findings.claim: Coinbase's public Borrow page lists XRP collateral with a maximum of $100,000 in USDC loans and says the loan is powered by Morpho; collateral moves on-chain and USDC proceeds are deposited into the Coinbase account.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Coinbase does not disclose what fraction of the public Morpho cbXRP/USDC market comes from Coinbase users.

findings.claim: The Base Morpho cbXRP/USDC market page displays 62.5% LLTV, 12.67% liquidation penalty, Chainlink XRP/USD oracle price $1.25055, $59.13M outstanding loans, $23.01M total liquidity, $82.14M market size and zero displayed bad debt.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: The displayed 90.49% utilization does not reconcile with the other displayed liquidity/borrow fields under the usual free-liquidity interpretation. The oracle 'value secured' field has unclear scope. Do not admit derived utilization or secured-value fields.

findings.claim: Coinbase's cbXRP proof-of-reserves page showed 151,405,263.6 XRP across 20 XRPL reserve addresses against 151,403,016.069 cbXRP supply at its October 30 refresh, approximately 100.00148% coverage.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: This is a dated reserve snapshot; Coinbase exchange-wallet aggregates may include the same reserve addresses. Never double-count reserve XRP and the wrapped token.

findings.claim: XRP Insights reports 22.37B XRP in 701 labeled exchange wallets, with a same-wallet-set seven-day change of -234.9M XRP; SBI VC Trade is labeled at 59.5M XRP.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Cold storage, customer assets, beneficial ownership and tradable inventory are not separated; label changes and new wallets can distort flows.

findings.claim: XRP Insights reports $4.33B XRPL RWA value but only $276M distributed/transferable; approximately $4.06B is registry value.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Registry representation is not freely transferable capital or evidence of XRP collateral demand.

findings.claim: A third-party dashboard reports approximately $4.47M native USDC on XRPL, while XRP Insights reports approximately $954.3M RLUSD on XRPL in its October 31 snapshot.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Different providers and capture times; verify issuer balances directly. Stablecoin supply is not equivalent to XRP demand.

findings.claim: Circle launched native USDC on XRPL and supports it through Circle Mint and Circle APIs; Circle's current product page lists 38 networks including XRPL and Arc.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Launch/support does not establish large current XRPL liquidity; third-party supply snapshot is only about $4.47M.

findings.claim: Circle's Arc mainnet announcement names SBI Group as a founding validator and Coinbase among exchange-access partners; Arc uses USDC as native gas and names Morpho as a credit-layer partner.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Coinbase is not a founding validator; Morpho's Arc integration does not prove the Base cbXRP market is deployed on Arc. Arc has a permissioned validator set and its launch disclaimer says it had no NYDFS or other regulatory approval.

findings.claim: SBI has direct XRP/XRPL ecosystem exposure through SBI Ripple Asia's XRPL proof of concept and remittance research, and SBI VC Trade's RLUSD distribution announcement.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: PoCs and listings do not prove production volumes, proprietary XRP inventory or net XRP purchases; the 59.5M SBI VC Trade wallet label is not beneficial-owner attribution.

findings.claim: SBI agreed to a 5% SMFG capital participation in SBI Startale Marketing and separately announced an MOU with BlackRock/Startale to explore tokenized money-market-fund connectivity to JPYSC.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Agreements and MOUs are not proof of completed funding, production product, public-chain circulation or settlement volume.

findings.claim: Coinbase introduced x402 and named Circle as a launch collaborator; T54, which describes itself as Ripple-backed, documents an XRPL x402 facilitator supporting XRP and issued tokens such as RLUSD.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: This is protocol-level interoperability. Coinbase's own facilitator is not shown operating T54's XRPL service.

findings.claim: XRPL documentation defines SourceTag as a merchant endpoint identifier, not an agent identity; a SourceTag cannot prove unique agent count or payer identity.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Payer attribution requires account-level transaction, invoice and authorization evidence.

findings.claim: T54 reported more than 10M XRPL x402 payments by October 1; a September 8 third-party report showed 4.49M tracked payments but only 5,836.71 XRP and 4,125.29 RLUSD settled.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Vendor-specific counter and historical snapshot; counts do not establish capital value, net XRP purchases or network-wide agent share.

findings.claim: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (Tokyo SBIC) held a June 12-13, 2025 training for investee companies that explicitly included ChatGPT and Copilot.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: This is education, not an OpenAI partnership, XRP investment or SBI Holdings relationship. Corrects an earlier misattributed date.

findings.claim: SBI is pursuing a multi-rail strategy spanning Ripple/XRPL/RLUSD, JPYSC/Startale/SMFG/BlackRock, Circle/USDC/Arc and Open Standard/Coinbase; this is not an exclusive XRP strategy.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Commercial interoperability and live capital flows among these rails remain only partly disclosed.

findings.claim: The Morpho cbXRP market creates a possible path from liquidation-seized cbXRP to native XRP through Coinbase Exchange unwrapping, but no liquidator-to-Coinbase deposit, unwrap or sale was established in this run.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Liquidators can hold, transfer or sell cbXRP elsewhere; the product mechanism alone is not evidence of native XRP sell pressure.

findings.claim: Alpha Finance reported about $2.82B XRP open interest while Liqwall reported about $1.32B within eight minutes; price was near $1.25-$1.26 and Liqwall funding was positive.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: About 2.14x OI discrepancy; contract universe and provider independence are not reconciled. Exclude composite OI feature.

findings.claim: The strongest candidate for 'Camilla Stephenson' is Dr. Kamilah Stevenson, who identifies her YouTube as 'doctor Camilla Stevenson' in a public XRP podcast interview; @drkamilahstevenson is a likely channel candidate.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Spelling differs and the interviewee warns of fake pages. Channel ownership is not fully authenticated; exhaustive video inventory not completed.

actual_capital_framework: Gross transfer volume is not net external capital.
Market capitalization is not an inflow.
Exchange-wallet balance changes are not automatically spot buying or selling; cold storage, wallet relabeling and new addresses must be reconciled.
ETF holdings/AUM are not daily net creations/redemptions.
RWA registry value is not transferable float; distinguish registered, issued, distributed, locked and freely transferable units.
Stablecoin supply is not XRP buy pressure; identify issuer, chain, settlement asset, counterparty and net mint/burn.
Morpho borrowing is USDC credit against existing collateral, not automatically new XRP spot demand.
cbXRP reserve XRP and cbXRP token supply represent the same underlying exposure and must not be double-counted.
x402 transaction count is not dollar value or XRP demand; measure XRP and RLUSD amounts separately and verify payer/invoice attribution.

source_discrepancies.detail: Displayed $59.13M loans, $23.01M total liquidity and $82.14M market size do not reconcile with displayed 90.49% utilization under the usual free-liquidity interpretation.
The $240.1M value-secured field does not identify whether it is market-specific or oracle-wide.
Alpha $2.82B vs Liqwall $1.32B within eight minutes.

source_discrepancies.issue: Coinbase cbXRP reserve and exchange balance overlap
source_discrepancies.detail: Coinbase PoR reserve addresses may be included in the third-party Coinbase exchange-wallet aggregate.
$4.06B registry value is not freely transferable; only $276M is reported distributed.
SourceTag identifies merchant endpoint, not payer agent.
Strong candidate Dr Kamilah Stevenson, but spelling and fake-page warning require channel-owner verification.

notes: No directional XRP forecast issued. Current provider observations are retained for research only and are not admitted as model features.

limitations: Morpho UI liquidity/utilization fields do not reconcile; use raw API state and onchain contract data.
Morpho REST does not enumerate all Blue market positions or liquidation history; Base event logs are required.
Coinbase-originated Morpho share is unknown; the market is permissionless.
Coinbase reserve XRP and cbXRP supply are one exposure; reserve addresses may overlap exchange-wallet totals.
Exchange-wallet balances include cold storage and are not tradable float or beneficial-owner attribution.
XRPL RWA registry value is not transferable float; distinguish distributed from registry records.
Stablecoin supply and x402 transaction count do not prove XRP purchases or net external capital.
SourceTag is a merchant endpoint identifier, not an agent identity.
Tokyo SBIC ChatGPT training is educational, not an OpenAI partnership.
Dr Kamilah Stevenson is a strong candidate for the requested Camilla Stephenson identity, but spelling and fake-page warning remain; exhaustive channel video inventory is incomplete.
